column1: # Bulgarian business-name words (curated 2026-11-10), also read for North Macedonia's Cyrillic
# names. Names follow the form-and-quotes model of the region or stand alone: Иванов Строй,
# Агро Петров, Балкан Транс. Words carry the official Bulgarian transliteration (2009) after "=",
# used for domains. A section key serves every division of the section that has no row of its own.
